summary: Verified REVERT of iteration-11 re-entry trailing mechanism (HiTechBot-native behaviour restored). Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_trailing_bot_logic.py: kept TrailingDCA / TrailingSELL / FirstBuyFreshBot classes; RE-PURPOSED TestReentryTrailingBuy to assert first buy fires IMMEDIATELY regardless of peak_price; RE-PURPOSED TestSellSeedsPeakForReentry to assert peak_price is 0 after SELL in both Cycle and One-Shot; added TestFreshBotWithHighPriceFiresBuy for the exact review-request scenario (peak=1000, buy_in_callback=1.0, price=1050 → BUY immediately). Extended TestBotDetailAPIExposesTrailingFields to assert on BOTH BTCUSDT and DOGEUSDT that reentry_armed is False, reentry_trigger_price==0, and trigger_state is in {waiting,tp_armed,dca_armed,start_pending,idle} (never reentry_armed). All 14 trailing tests pass. Full backend suite: 96 passed / 2 failed — both failures are the pre-existing stale hard-coded assertions in test_bots_list.py (BTC buy_count expected 8 got 9; DOGE expected 1 got 30). The DOGE count grew from 26→30 since iteration-11, confirming the fix: DOGE fired its first buy of the new cycle immediately (pos_qty=652.83 units visible on /pair/DOGEUSDT). Frontend /pair/BTCUSDT and /pair/DOGEUSDT both render Operation Reminder without the re-entry chip, and [data-testid=reentry-tracker] is absent from the DOM on both. 6-tab bottom nav intact, DCA ladder rows present. Backend logs clean, no exceptions.

minor.issue: tests/test_bots_list.py::TestBotsList::test_btcusdt_expected_counts_and_profit — hard-coded buy_count==8 but actual is 9. Grows over time as live BTC bot trades. Same pattern as DOGE stale assertion flagged in iteration-11.

tests/test_bots_list.py::TestBotsList::test_dogeusdt_expected — hard-coded buy_count==1 but actual is 30. Grew from 26 (iter-11) → 30 (now), confirming the immediate-first-buy fix is working. Recommend replacing hard-coded values with buy_count>=1 sanity checks.

action_items: MINOR: Convert the two hard-coded buy_count/sell_count assertions in tests/test_bots_list.py to relative sanity checks (>=1) so they don't drift with live bot trading. Not caused by this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 1690 lines — same recommendation as prior iterations to split into bots/trades/market/auth/engine modules.
server.py still uses @app.on_event startup/shutdown (deprecated) — should be moved to FastAPI lifespan.
_bot_tick FIRST BUY block (server.py ~1128-1148) is now clean: guard is simply `if position_qty == 0`. No peak/trough gating for entry. Verified by 4 new tests.
SELL reset blocks (server.py ~987-996 for real, ~1070-1080 for demo) both set peak_price=0.0 for Cycle mode. last_sell_price is still recorded for reference. Consistent with HiTechBot spec.
get_bot (server.py ~625) hard-codes reentry_armed=False and reentry_trigger_price=0 on every response — regardless of stored DB state. Good defensive design for the revert.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Trailing tests require pytest-asyncio (installed) and /app/backend/tests/pytest.ini pins loop scope='session' (do not change — motor binds to event loop at import). Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. To retest UI, remember re-entry has been removed: chip labels are only {TP Armed, DCA Armed, Waiting for trigger, First buy pending, Idle}. [data-testid=reentry-tracker] MUST NOT exist. reentry_armed and reentry_trigger_price are hard-coded to False/0 in get_bot response regardless of DB state — do not rely on DB peak_price to test these flags. DOGE bot has active running position (pos_qty~653) — good live sample. BTC currently pos_qty~0.000323, actively trading. The two failing test_bots_list assertions are pre-existing tech debt.
